title: Unlock Your Full Height with Rulo
mascot_sheet: Full body character model sheet of Rulo, a light wooden cartoon school ruler with black centimeter measurement lines. He has large expressive cartoon eyes, tiny stick arms and legs, clean bold outlines, flat colors, plain white background.
voice: Fast, energetic, comedic, relatable young voice.
music: Bouncy upbeat cartoon instrumental, 125 BPM, light marimba and pizzicato strings.

scenes.vo: Can you actually get taller naturally?
scenes.prompt: Rulo the wooden ruler cartoon slouching sadly, looking down at his own marks with a horrified face, solid yellow background.

scenes.vo: First, fix your posture to unlock hidden height.
scenes.prompt: Rulo snapping straight like an arrow, beaming proudly with sparkling eyes, solid light blue background.

scenes.vo: Hang daily to decompress your spine.
scenes.prompt: Rulo hanging by his tiny hands from a pull-up bar, stretching comically long, mint green background.

scenes.vo: Fuel up on protein, calcium, and vitamin D.
scenes.prompt: Rulo juggling a giant egg, milk bottle, and broccoli, sweating happily, bright orange background.

scenes.vo: Deep sleep lets your spine recover overnight.
scenes.prompt: Rulo sleeping soundly in a cozy bed, snoring cartoon z-bubbles floating upward, dark navy background.

scenes.vo: No magical pills—just solid daily habits.
scenes.prompt: Rulo swatting away floating shady supplement bottles with a resolute smirk, pastel purple background.

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.
scenes.prompt: Rulo happily pointing at a large floating smartphone displaying a progress chart, warm yellow background.
